progress_events.note: Join native list/read normalization with RecentMessages; verify two isolated chat fixtures and preserve unknown correlation refs as null.

changes.result: V090 chain joined: ZaiReader::list_chats exposes stable IDs from page 1; read_chat parses provider batch; recent_messages projects role-separated user/assistant slots while preserving message IDs and observed timestamps. Two isolated synthetic native payloads prove each chat retains its own role slots and IDs. The captured provider shape has no turn/reply/completion metadata, so turn_id, reply_to_input_id, assistant_replies_to_user, partial, and truncated remain None rather than inferred. Verification on origin/main 61e51b66: cargo test --manifest-path crates/herder/Cargo.toml adapters::zai --offline — 6 passed; rustfmt +stable --edition 2024 --check and git diff --check passed. Commit eceb2031; prior V090A/B commits bc5f3ac1 and e2b820b3. Live two-chat provider readback remains unverified.
changes.note: Owned source/fixture chain done without profile access or marker resend. Live consumer proof remains a separately scoped acceptance.
